## What We Did

<!-- CHANGE THIS: replace with your own notes -->

I learned more about how Python and github workflows can be used for website creation. I also learned that unlike most GIS technologies it renders all of your data on your local computer before pushing the product to the internet.

## Key Concepts

Three places a file can live:

1. **My computer** — where I edit
2. **GitHub.com** — where it's stored
3. **My live site** — what the world sees

The loop: **Edit → Save → Render → Commit → Push → wait → refresh**

## Proving R Works

The chunk below runs when this page renders. If you can see a result underneath
it on your published site, R and Quarto are talking to each other correctly.
